description: List the law bills of a Diet session (default: current; past sessions from 142 (1998) as loaded, see jp_diet_sessions_list; 閣法 = cabinet bills, 衆法/参法 = member bills of the House of Representatives/Councillors) with where each is now: status as published (審議状況, e.g. 成立 = enacted), a status code, the position read from published stages (e.g. in_committee), latest stage date and source URLs. Filters: session, house, kind, status, title words. Free.

house.description: Only bills now with this house, according to the published status

kind.description: Bill kind: 閣法 or cabinet (cabinet bill), 衆法 or hr_member (House of Representatives member bill), 参法 or hc_member (House of Councillors member bill)

query.description: Words in the bill title, in Japanese (for example 消費税 = consumption tax)

session.description: Diet session number, for example 222 (default: the current session)

status.description: Only bills with this status code (see status_meaning in the answer)

name: jp_diet_bills_list

bill_id.description: submitted session - kind - number, for example 222-閣法-1

current.description: Where the bill is now, from published stages only (not a forecast).

status_ja.description: 審議状況 as published on the House of Representatives list (null when the bill is not on it).

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: current / recent (read every day), loading / loaded / loaded_with_gaps (past sessions), or not_loaded.

source.description: Where the answer comes from and how fresh it is.

current_session.description: Current (or latest) Diet session number read from the House of Representatives list.

retrieved_at.description: When this service last read the current session's House of Representatives bill list.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: Japan Diet: law bills of a session
